title: A container theorem for general digraphs with forbidden subdigraphs
summary: In a seminal work, Kühn, Osthus, Townsend, and Zhao used the hypergraph container method to determine the typical structure of oriented graphs and digraphs avoiding a fixed tournament or cycle. Their main tool, a container theorem for oriented graphs, does not directly extend to all digraphs due to the existence of counterexamples such as the double triangle $DK_3$. In this paper we prove a container theorem for general digraphs under a natural sparsity condition.
